headline: Central Front Reeling as Linn of Mercy and Weathered Expanse Trade Blows
war_summary: The past three hours saw a furious spike of combat along the contested central line, where Linn of Mercy logged six strategic base events in two hours centered on Outwich Ranch. Weathered Expanse remains a fierce meatgrinder, adding two more base transitions and over eleven hundred combined casualties in the latest two hours around Spirit Watch and Frostmarch. Pari Peak and Stlican Shelf registered fresh base exchanges as well, with contested fighting touching Pariah and Breaker Town. In contrast, Marban Hollow and Kuura Strand have cooled since the earlier flurry, recording no flag turnovers over the last two hours despite ongoing skirmishes. Meanwhile, high-casualty grinding persists across Callahan's Passage, Stonecradle, Farranac Coast, and Olavis Wake without shifting strategic holdings, while The Gutter remains quiet following yesterday's extensive churn.
